title: Please: Water, Bread, Tea, Key
label: ch:fa-please-requests
canDo: I can politely ask for water, bread, tea, or my key in Persian, and I can name the four vocabulary layers those four words come from.

payoff.summary: The chapter closes on kelid, a Greek loan, then runs all four requests back to back — âb, nân, chây, kelid, each with lotfan — and reuses the ezafe from Chapter 2 to ask for kelid-e man, my key.
